data.long_meaning: Someone who is great, large or grand. The name Akbari carries the meaning “Great, Big” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akbari usually hope their child will grow to embody great, big and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Akbari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great, Big.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akbari total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أكبري
in_arabic.meaning: يعني الأكبر أو الأعظم في الصفات الحميدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أكبري مشتق من الجذر العربي ك-ب-ر، ويعني الأكبر أو الأعظم في الصفات الحميدة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياق التكبير والتعظيم لله تعالى. يستخدم الاسم للدلالة على العظمة والكبرياء في المعنى الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: اکبری
in_urdu.meaning: اکبر یا اعظم کے معنی میں، عالی شان و مرتبت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام اکبری عربی جڑ ک-ب-ر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بڑا یا عظیم۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بڑے یا اعظم کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور یہ اکثر اللہ کی عظمت و کبریائی کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس کا استعمال ایک اعلیٰ درجے کی عزت و احترام کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अकबरी
in_hindi.meaning: अकबर या सबसे बड़े के अर्थ में, उच्च सम्मान
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम अकबरी अरबी मूल क-ب-र से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सबसे बड़ा या महान। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बड़े या सबसे महान के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है, और अक्सर इसका उपयोग अल्लाह की महानता और महिमा के लिए किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उच्च सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: اکبری
in_pashto.meaning: د لوی یا اعظم په معنی، لوړ پوړی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د اکبری نوم د عربي ريښو ک-ب-ر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې لوی یا اعظم دی. دا نوم د اسلامي دودیزو کې د لوی یا اعظم په معنی کارول کیږي، او ډیری وختونه د الله تعالی د عظمت او کبر لپاره کارول کیږي. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې، دا نوم د لوړ پوړو او عزت لرونکو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Akbari
in_english.long_meaning: The name Akbari is derived from the Arabic root k-b-r, which means 'to be great' or 'to be powerful'. In Islamic tradition, the name Akbari signifies 'the greatest' or 'the most exalted', often referring to Allah's attributes. Historically, the name has been used to denote someone of high status or nobility. It carries spiritual significance, reflecting the values of greatness, majesty, and exaltation in Islam.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Akbari" is of Persian origin and is commonly used among Muslims, especially in Iran and South Asia. It is a title of respect and signifies greatness, importance, and excellence. This name has been associated with various historical figures such as Akbar the Great Mughal Emperor of India (1542-1605), who is known for his administration and contributions to Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name "Akbar" is also used to refer to Allah (God) Himself, as mentioned in the Quran. Allah is the Greatest of all and the Sustainer of the Universe. The use of the name "Akbari" can be seen as a reminder of the greatness and majesty of Allah. It is a name that instills a sense of awe, reverence and humility in a Muslim. The spiritual significance of this name encourages individuals to strive for greatness not in worldly matters, but in their relationship with Allah, by living a virtuous and righteous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Great, Big" symbolizes Someone who is great, large or grand. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Akbari serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of great, big.
